description: To successfully complete something or reach a goal.
translation: Lograr o alcanzar algo con éxito.
example: She worked hard to achieve her career goals.

description: To trust or depend on someone or something.
translation: Confiar o depender de alguien o algo.
example: You can rely on him to finish the job on time.

description: To indicate or mention something specific.
example: The teacher pointed out several mistakes in the essay.

description: Unwilling or hesitant to do something.
translation: Reacio o poco dispuesto a hacer algo.
example: He was reluctant to change his plans at the last minute.

description: To understand or solve something after thinking about it.
translation: Entender o resolver algo después de pensarlo.
example: It took me a while to figure out how the app worked.
